components.name: Poster Sleeve
components.description: Missing-poster state, without inventing catalog metadata.

narrative.overview:
A cinematic night scene frames a practical personal catalog. Pink illuminated lettering and cyan details recall a video-store frontage, while navy surfaces give real film artwork room to carry the browsing experience.

The interface pairs expressive italic display lettering with readable, compact controls. Atmosphere belongs in the masthead and decorative storefront; catalog information remains live text.
keyCharacteristics: Illuminated pink display text and cyan interaction cues.
Dark rectangular controls and closely framed poster sleeves.
Real catalog imagery, restrained movement, and visible keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Signage Rule
rules.body: Reserve luminous text shadows for the brand, display heading and selected tabs; keep descriptions and filter labels readable without glow.

dos: Do preserve real artwork and readable factual labels.
Do retain responsive poster columns, cyan keyboard focus and reduced motion support.
Do preserve generated artwork provenance and font licensing.
donts: Don't replace real catalog data with generated posters or scores.
Don't embed functional labels in imagery.
Don't extend glow or movement to every label.
